_readme: Motives for the 39 premade slots (world-slots.json at d69115c). Keyed by slot because non-story slots get random names. 'motive' is for authors and the online/local model prompt only, never shown. 'aside' is one speech line the cat may say unprompted in a meeting or presence scene, with no tokens and no numbers. 'gossip' is how other cats talk about them, with {name} = this cat. Wants stay flavour only (Director ruling): nothing here creates a mechanic, reward or promise. Secrets in loners.md are never stated; lines only hint. Unnamed slots are never named in another cat's line, only by role. Sources: world-gen-spec.md slot table, world-and-prides.md, loners.md.

hc01.motive: Keep Highcrag's order and lineage unbroken, and keep the truth about the fallen cub buried.
hc01.aside: “Mind our law while you're near the crag. I'd rather not have to say it.”
hc01.gossip: “{name} never hurries. Not even when the river came up over the banks.”

hc02.motive: Earn his mother's place and outrun the day the fallen cub is spoken of.
hc02.aside: “Everyone on the crag is waiting for me to slip up. Well, they'll be waiting a while.”
hc02.gossip: “{name} trains harder than anybody on the crag. It's like something's chasing that cat.”

hc03.motive: Stand behind the leader and keep the crag fed with big game; wants the young ones taught to wait.
hc03.aside: “You look hungry. Most hunters miss because they can't wait, so wait.”
hc03.gossip: “{name} doesn't say much, but the crag eats well thanks to {name}.”

hc04.motive: Belong on the crag completely, though he has always felt like the cat who doesn't quite fit.
hc04.aside: “The old cats on the crag look at me like they're trying to place me. I wish somebody would just tell me why.”
hc04.gossip: “{name} grew up on the crag, but nobody tells the same story about where {name} came from.”

hc05.motive: Be the best stalker on the crag and be trusted with the hunts that matter.
hc05.aside: “Snow shows every track if you know how to read it. That's how I find my hares.”
hc05.gossip: “If there's a hare on the high meadow, {name} has found it already.”

hc06.motive: Keep her cubs safe and the dens peaceful; wants the arguments kept away from the nursery.
hc06.aside: “If you go near our dens, keep your voice down, please. Cubs need their sleep, and so do I.”
hc06.gossip: “{name} is the calmest cat on the crag, especially around the cubs.”

hc07.motive: Guard the crag and its law. Still carries her daughter's leaving, and won't show it.
hc07.aside: “I've guarded this crag a long time. If you've come to lure anybody away from it, don't.”
hc07.gossip: “{name} hasn't been the same since that daughter left. Just don't say so where {name} can hear.”

hc08.motive: Keep every name in the recitation; dreads a name being lost.
hc08.aside: “I keep the names of every Highcrag cat who ever lived. Somebody has to, and I'm not getting any younger.”
hc08.gossip: “{name} knows the name of every cat back to the start of the crag, even a few the crag would rather forget.”

hc09.motive: Prove he's grown, and get out from under being the leader's youngest.
hc09.aside: “They keep telling me I'll hunt big game soon. Soon, soon. I'm sick of soon.”
hc09.gossip: “{name} follows the hunters everywhere and thinks nobody notices. Everybody notices.”

hc10.motive: Play, explore and find out what's past the dens.
hc10.aside: “Are you from far away? Further than the ledge? I've never been past the ledge.”
hc10.gossip: “{name} always ends up a paw further from the den than allowed.”

hc11.motive: Stay warm and near his mother; everything is new.
hc11.aside: The cub squeaks and ducks out of sight.
hc11.gossip: “{name} is the newest cub on the crag.”

bf01.motive: Hold Bonefield by strength and keep every challenger afraid; watches for weakness, including his own.
bf01.aside: “Plenty of cats have tried to take this field from me. None of them are still around.”
bf01.gossip: “{name} won the field in a challenge and has held it ever since. Nobody dares guess what happens when {name} finally loses.”

bf02.motive: Rise in rank. Torn between what he owes the field and what he once wanted at the ford.
bf02.aside: “In Bonefield you take what you want or you go without. I'm still working out what I want.”
bf02.gossip: “{name} used to spend a lot of time down at the ford. Not any more.”

bf03.motive: Bring down the biggest prey in the Vale and be respected for it.
bf03.aside: “Anybody can catch a hare. Talk to me when you've stood up to a bison.”
bf03.gossip: “{name} has more kills than scars, and in Bonefield that's rare.”

bf04.motive: Keep her cubs strong enough to survive Bonefield, and keep her mate's rule steady.
bf04.aside: “My cubs are going to be fighters. In Bonefield they'll have to be.”
bf04.gossip: “{name} hunts at the leader's side and keeps an eye out when the leader won't.”

bf05.motive: Feed her cub and earn rank through clean kills, not noise.
bf05.aside: “I like a quick, clean kill. The prey doesn't suffer, and I don't waste my strength.”
bf05.gossip: “{name} kills faster than anybody in the field and makes less fuss about it.”

bf06.motive: Find a place in a pride that only listens to the loud; she notices what others miss.
bf06.aside: “Everybody in Bonefield shouts. I'd rather keep quiet and listen. You hear more that way.”
bf06.gossip: “{name} reads trails better than cats far older, not that anybody in the field cares.”

bf07.motive: Survive and stay useful. Carries the shame of bowing without a fight and the memory of the leader he once guarded.
bf07.aside: “I've guarded Bonefield's leaders for a long time. You learn which fights are worth it. At least, I hope I did.”
bf07.gossip: “{name} bowed to the new leader without a fight, and the field still argues about whether that was wise.”

bf08.motive: Win her father's approval and her first challenge.
bf08.aside: “I bet I could beat you in a fight. Probably. Maybe.”
bf08.gossip: “{name} takes after that father and wants everybody to know it.”

bf09.aside: The cub growls a tiny growl and pounces on your bobtail.
bf09.gossip: “{name} has already started picking fights with the grass.”

bf10.aside: The cub peers at you with round eyes and doesn't come any closer.
bf10.gossip: “{name} is the youngest in the field.”

mw01.motive: Hold the broken pride together; carries the leadership no one else would take, and the grief of the Breaking.
mw01.aside: “We were a much bigger pride before the Breaking. Now I'm holding together what's left.”
mw01.gossip: “{name} took the lead after the Breaking because nobody else would, and hasn't rested since.”

mw02.motive: Protect his mate and cub; one of the few toms left after the ice.
mw02.aside: “I made it out of the ice. Plenty of cats didn't, so now I keep watch.”
mw02.gossip: “{name} still won't go anywhere near the Mere.”

mw03.motive: Prove a young, scarred tom is still worth something to a pride that lost its strongest.
mw03.aside: “My leg's fine, before you ask. It's slower than it was, that's all. I can still walk all night.”
mw03.gossip: “{name} was barely grown when the ice broke. These days {name} hardly ever stops to rest.”

mw04.motive: Keep her family fed and hidden; trusts very few.
mw04.aside: “You don't know where our dens are, and I'd like to keep it that way. No offence.”
mw04.gossip: “They say {name} could track a goose through the thickest fog.”

mw05.motive: Keep the old trails alive and teach them before more are lost.
mw05.aside: “Every Mistwood cat used to know the safe paths through the marsh. Now hardly any of us remember them.”
mw05.gossip: “{name} walks the old marsh trails every season so the pride won't forget them.”

mw06.motive: Want a pride that laughs again; gentle, hopeful, a little lonely.
mw06.aside: “It's been so quiet in the Mistwood. It's nice to hear a new voice.”
mw06.gossip: “{name} still talks to everybody who passes, even after the Breaking.”

mw07.motive: Guard what Mistwood knows and nurse it through; old, half-blind, unhurried.
mw07.aside: “I've seen more winters than you have teeth, young cat. Sit down and tell me what you're looking for.”
mw07.gossip: “{name} is the oldest cat in the Mistwood and remembers things nobody else does.”

mw08.motive: Live up to a father who drowned leading the pride; afraid of the ice and of being him.
mw08.aside: “Everybody says I'll lead the Mistwood someday. My father led it too, and the Mere drowned my father.”
mw08.gossip: “{name} is the drowned leader's son, and the pride keeps waiting to see if {name} will turn out the same.”

mw09.motive: Be a cub in a pride that needs her to be hope.
mw09.aside: The cub peeks out at you from the reeds, then ducks back in.
mw09.gossip: “No cub was born in the Mistwood after the Breaking until {name}.”

ln01.motive: Endure exile with dignity; wants the truth kept from shaming the crag, and to be judged fairly by someone.
ln01.aside: “I used to know every name on the crag. Now nobody there says mine. That's how it goes.”
ln01.gossip: “{name} used to advise the Highcrag leader, until the leader drove {name} out. No argument, no fuss.”

ln02.motive: Find out why the cat she left for never came, and find somewhere she belongs.
ln02.aside: “I left the crag to meet somebody at the Split Rock, and nobody came. I'm starting to wonder why I'm still waiting.”
ln02.gossip: “{name} left the crag on a warm summer night and still sits by the Split Rock some evenings.”

ln03.motive: Get back what Scarjaw took from him; uses anyone to get close enough for a second chance.
ln03.aside: “Go on, look at the cheek. Everybody does. Nobody asks how close I came to winning before I got it.”
ln03.gossip: “{name} challenged the Bonefield leader and very nearly won.”

ln04.motive: Be done with Bonefield's noise; protects cubs fiercely and quietly.
ln04.aside: “I got tired of Bonefield's noise. That's all you need to know about why I left.”
ln04.gossip: “{name} walked out of Bonefield and never said why.”

ln05.motive: See what lies beyond the edge of the Vale and never be stuck anywhere.
ln05.aside: “Have you ever been north past the Ice Wall? No? You should go. Everybody should.”
ln05.gossip: “{name} comes and goes like the weather. You'll see that cat when the hunting's thin.”

ln06.motive: Live out her days with some warmth; too proud to ask to be carried home.
ln06.aside: “Sit with me a while, if you like. I don't get much company out here.”
ln06.gossip: “Mistwood thinks {name} is dead, and {name} would rather keep it that way than be seen this frail.”

ln07.motive: Carry what he did without excuses; wants nothing from anyone except to be left alone.
ln07.aside: “Yes, I did what they say I did. Don't ask me why.”
ln07.gossip: “{name} was driven out of the Mistwood for stealing food from the starving, and has never denied it.”

ln08.motive: Find the family she lost; can't stop searching the river.
ln08.aside: “Have you seen any cubs along the river? Anywhere at all? I keep looking.”
ln08.gossip: “{name} walks the river every day, looking for the cubs it took.”

ln09.motive: Find his way back to Mistwood, and dreads facing those who were on the ice.
ln09.aside: “Do you know where the Mistwood dens are now? They moved, and I can't find their scent anywhere.”
ln09.gossip: “{name} has been looking for the Mistwood ever since the ice. The pride moved, and {name} can't find them.”
